blocks.html:
• Overview

  • Open days Bachelor's Degrees

Would you like to discover the Università della Svizzera italiana and our study programmes?
Click on the tab "Open Days Bachelor's Degrees" to know more about our future events.
If you wish to schedule a personalised orientation meeting, contact the Study Advisory Service. You will find the answers to all your questions!

For the 2026/2027 academic year, we are organising several orientation events for our Bachelor's Degrees on our campuses in Lugano and Mendrisio.

We offer different formats of Open Days:

  • During the Bachelor Info Day, you’ll spend half a day at USI. We’ll give you a general introduction to the university and its services, followed by a more specific presentation of the Bachelor's programme you’re interested in, where you’ll also meet the programme director.
  • The Bachelor Ministage is a more immersive event held over two days: you’ll be welcomed on campus and spend two full days attending classes, giving you a real taste of the Bachelor's programme and the student experience. You’ll also have the chance to stay overnight and have dinner in Lugano or Mendrisio — a great opportunity to explore the city and meet other future students like yourself!
  • With the Bachelor Meetings, you can attend selected lectures to get a feel for what is taught in the degree programme you’re considering.

You can mark the following dates in your agenda:

Autumn Semester

  • Saturday 10 October 2026: Bachelor Info Day (in-person only) ! Registration open – Click here to register !
  • Monday to Wendesday 26–28 October 2026: Bachelor Meetings (in-person only)
  • Tuesday and Wendesday 10–11 November 2026: Bachelor Ministage (in-person only)

Spring Semester

  • Saturday 6 March 2027: Bachelor Info Day (in-person only)
  • Monday to Thursday, 15–18 March 2027: Bachelor Ministage (in-person only)
  • Monday to Friday, 5–9 April 2027: Bachelor Meetings (in-person only)

Advance registration is mandatory to attend all these events. Registration forms for each event will open a few weeks before the event itself.

If you would like to receive an email when registration opens for upcoming events, please sign up using this form (remember to accept all privacy conditions to allow us to contact you!).

Alternatively, you can always book an individual appointment — contact the Study Advisory: you’ll find answers to all your questions!
